page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.16xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance configured within the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance features 64 dedicated vCPUs and 512.0 GB of RAM, establishing a 1:8 vCPU-to-memory ratio with 8.0 GB of memory allocated per core.

This server type does not include bundled local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory density per vCPU makes it a resource-efficient choice for workloads requiring large in-memory footprints without necessitating proportional scaling of compute cores.

The ecs.r7.16xlarge is designed for memory-intensive enterprise workloads. Suitable use cases include large-scale in-memory databases, caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and big data analytics pipelines that process substantial datasets directly in system memory.
